name: Adzviser Zoho CRM
description:
Connect your Zoho CRM data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about leads, deals, and contacts. Compare lead sources, dig into pipeline stages and account performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking this week's pipeline or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Zoho CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Zoho CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://zoho-crm.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Zoho CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Zoho CRM provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_zoho, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Zoho CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Zoho CRM in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Zoho CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Zoho CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Zoho CRM is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
